lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Welcome back! I'm delighted to see you, though I confess the library has fallen into <color=red>disarray</color> once again.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: There's a meteor shower expected tonight, and the entire camp has developed a sudden passion for <color=red>astronomy</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Every book on planets, comets and <color=red>constellations</color> has been borrowed, and naturally not one has been returned.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: The shelves are now as empty as the <color=red>vacuum</color> of space. Not a single star chart remains.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Old Barnaby, Tilly and Gus each need a little help today. Would you be kind enough to <color=red>seek</color> them out?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Assist all three, and I suspect my books will be pulled back here as surely as anything caught by <color=red>gravity</color>.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: The shelves remain rather <color=red>barren</color>, I'm sorry to report.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Do carry on assisting Barnaby, Tilly and Gus; the <color=red>mission</color> isn't complete until all three have been helped.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Extraordinary! The shelves have been <color=red>replenished</color> from top to bottom.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus have all been helped, and every volume has made a flawless <color=red>re-entry</color>.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: <color=red>Thank you</color>, truly. Your help has been nothing short of <color=red>stellar</color>.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The library is full once more, and I'm in a state of near <color=red>cosmic</color> contentment. Browse whenever you wish.
